answer:
The first spacecraft ever to approach Uranus was **Voyager 2**, which made its closest approach to Uranus on January 24, 1986. This spacecraft was launched on **August 20, 1977**, by NASA on a **Titan IIIE/Centaur** launch vehicle from Space Launch Complex 41 at Cape Canaveral, Florida.

Voyager 2 remains the only spacecraft to have visited Uranus and Neptune. Its mission provided humanity's most detailed close-up views of these two giant planets, along with Jupiter and Saturn before them.
